apiNotice.title: API Key Required

step1.title: Upload a main image, describe the motion

mainImage.label: Main image
mainImage.desc: 1 image to animate it, 2-3 to add reference elements; none for text only

idea.label: Motion
idea.desc: One sentence, e.g. "the product slowly rotates, soft light"

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.desc: Resolution, length, things to avoid, end frame (optional)

step2.title: Review the prompt
step2.descHighlight: subject & motion, setting, camera, lighting and sound
items: Click an alternative below a field to swap it in

step3.title: Generate

script.label: Compose the prompt
script.desc: Turn the fields into an English description Gemini Omni understands best

generate.label: Generate
generate.desc: Gemini Omni creates visuals and sound in about 30 s to 1 min

extend.label: Extend
extend.desc: Describe what happens next to make it longer, up to 40 s

step3.tip: Download the video or check the exact English prompt on the right
